thread:
maya: Cutting RC candidate rc-2024-03-1 now. Pinned artifact gcr.io/redwood/serve:rc-2024-03-1 (sha256:9f3a2b...). Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.internal/release/rc-2024-03-1 :party:
sam: ack. Any infra/config deltas besides kv-warm?
tanvi: only kv-warm + lowering batch size for encoder in prod-east. Added to notes.
release-bot: [automated] RC created rc-2024-03-1 by maya. CI: build ✅ unit/integration ✅ e2e flaky but passing. Artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/serve:rc-2024-03-1. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% over 20m.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: PROMOTE rc-2024-03-1 to canary in prod-east. Command: `/deploy promote rc-2024-03-1 --region prod-east --plan canary-5-25-20m`
prashant: I'll be sheriff for this window, 30m initial watch, paged on >0.5% 5xx or >30% latency regressions.
maya: starting rollout: step1 -> 5% at 1739812400. KV warm kick at +30s.
sam: copied rollout commands to ops runbook.
ops-sheriff: seeing a small spike in 503s on embeddings-encoder around +40s after step1 :eyes:
prashant: looking into logs, possible OOMs on r-infer-gpu-3-9 node pool. Scaling not triggered fast enough.
tanvi: can we flip to the cpu-quantized variant as fallback? It's slightly higher latency but stable.
maya: enable fallback policy and pause rollout. Command: `/deploy set-policy rc-2024-03-1 --fallback cpu-quantized --pause`
deploy-bot: policy updated: fallback=cpu-quantized, rollout paused by maya.
prashant: confirming: enabling fallback routed 100% of the canary slice to cpu-quantized, 503s dropped to baseline. Will collect logs for 10m.
prashant: root cause likely load spike + aggressive batch size; OOM in encoder container, node autoscaler slow because of taints.
sam: suggest short rollback to last stable rc while we patch node pool autoscaler and adjust batch size.
maya: agree. Initiating rollback to rc-2024-02-9 to restore service quickly. `/deploy rollback --to rc-2024-02-9 --region prod-east --reason "encoder OOM during canary"`
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for prod-east. Shifting canary 5% -> 0% over 60s. will report when complete.
release-bot: [automated] Rollback complete. Current active candidate: rc-2024-02-9. All health checks green.
ops-sheriff: post-rollback telemetry: p50/p95 latency back to expected, 5xx -> 0.02% within 3m.
prashant: I'll own a brief postmortem. Action items: (1) bump encoder pod memory, (2) make autoscaler reactive to tainted pools, (3) revert batch-size delta until autoscale tested, (4) add synthetic canary load test to catch this.
tanvi: I'll revert the batch-size change in the candidate branch and prepare a patched RC.
maya: reopening candidate after fixes. Will run a local bake + staged canary at 1% then 5% for 15m each before promos. Pin to prevent auto-promotion: `/deploy pin rc-2024-03-1 --hold`
sam: adding a tidy release-note snapshot and linking the postmortem in the notes: https://docs.redwood.internal/release/rc-2024-03-1#postmortem
prashant: thanks. Marking this rollout as aborted, keeping the quiet window for 60m to allow infra changes.
maya: good call. We'll re-run the promote once postmortem and infra fixes are in. Thanks everyone for fast triage :heart:
ops-sheriff: ack. Leaving sheriff channel, will rejoin when you re-schedule the bake.
sam: will update the change calendar and stamp the RC with `hold: true`.
maya: closing thread, follow-ups tracked in the postmortem doc.
